strategy_statement: CS2 and Dota 2 in-play bot; from 10-16 a buy-only two-sided maker plus an informed taker (one signing key, owner 0x8af810f0, for both legs and both regimes), before that a round-trip taker in GRID tier-1/2 events. [VALIDATE-only] Selection: whole events (match + all maps) of non-GRID CS2 / Dota 2 leagues that its push-feed product covers (group P: P4e, 0x2005d16a, the slow trio; GRID events are covered by another subscriber group with the same delivery order, so the boundary is its product, not data speed); frozen v5 (league / popularity score + group-P coverage in the previous 72 h) pooled AUC 0.970 vs activity 0.886, recall 0.74 at lift 3.16, coverage 1.0. [VALIDATE-only] Maker: whole-cent BUY ladders near the touch on both outcome tokens (100 shares in CS2, 10 in Dota 2), never sells, merges pairs in one 300-s loop (97% paired, pair cost 0.978); the per-market margin is made by its price level (its own prices quoted continuously earn +1.3%, the public anchor at its own windows loses 2.3-4.5%), and that level is not predicted by public game state or public tape state. [hypothesis, BUILD-live] Its quote level is an informed private value: the offset of its adds from the others' mid predicts the others' mid move (Spearman 0.44 at 10 s vs 0.17 for other makers; 0.38 without any public trigger), does not follow prior public moves of its own or the sibling book, and its informative re-pricings precede the slower feed subscribers' takes (11% of them within 1 s, ~10x null). [hypothesis, BUILD-live] Protection: at its own takes it pulls the complement at +11-19 ms and re-posts after the FAK returns (~1.03 s); between takes it re-prices on the private input (ground-truth wallet cancels -0.94c in 10 s). [hypothesis] Taker: FAK BUYs on raw in-round messages of one broadcast esports push feed (P4e first, the wallet +50 ms, a slow trio with a load-dependent queue; machine-timed on isolated Dota kills; its Dota half at the spectator delay) of the plant / turn kind, at the stale ask plus its own premium. [VALIDATE-only] Economics: per-market PnL is the locked pair margin; the informed counterparty that takes its residual is group P (14.8% of its maker shares); public replays do not track its per-market PnL (best executable 0.25 / 0.09, below the co-occurrence baseline).

Frozen v5 = logistic(1.25 logit(v4 league/popularity score) + 1.19 log1p(gp72) - 1.11), gp72 = group-P members with a print in another event of the league in the previous 72 h: VALIDATE pooled AUC 0.970 vs activity 0.886 (gain +0.084 [0.030, 0.152]), recall 0.744 at lift 3.155; CS2 0.972, Dota 0.926; coverage 1.0 / 1.0. timing.description: Taker: messages of a shared esports push feed (>= 19 subscribers at fixed lags, 29% of its take clusters co-signed on the same token, 38.5% in any market of the event; P4e 0, 0x2005d16a +25, the wallet +50, three at ~+200, P93 ~+400 ms; lag invariant across event classes within ~10 ms; not shared in football / NBA / tennis), of the plant / turn kind; raw events priced by each subscriber (premium corr with P4e 0.21). Its Dota takes are on the same fan-out (P4e 50 ms earlier on 22% of them; slower co-signers 0xfe8a28be / 0x2529c68d / 0x72aaaaf9 at +450-500 ms). Maker: at its own takes it pulls the complement at +11-19 ms and re-posts after the FAK returns (~1.03 s); between takes it re-prices the ladder without any public trigger (single-order moves in 6 ms, multi-level pulls re-added in ~0.26 s), and these re-pricings precede adverse moves (validated label -0.60c, ground-truth wallet cancels -0.94c in 10 s, other makers' +0.74c); the take hazard rises with them (weak). Not a public execution filter (take vs strip-only AUC 0.52). Iteration 9: the fan-out is one broadcast (order consistency at the marginals' null, common-mode lag residual r 0.86) with a load-dependent slow tier (the trio); the Dota kill messages look machine-timed on isolated kills; the Dota maker bursts are only weakly locked to kills (13% vs 10% within 6 s). Uncensored adds: its informative re-pricings (up on the token / down on the complement) precede 11% of the slower subscribers' takes within 1 s (about 10x the shifted null): the maker leg moves on the feed's messages.

side.description: Maker: both outcomes in every market, CS2 and Dota (VALIDATE-only). Taker: the team that gained in-round on plant / turn events (first informed move against the previous burst). Side is not scored (two-sided at market level).

price.description: Maker: whole-cent BUY ladders near the touch (adds at touch 28%, +1 14%, -1 10%, down to -5 13%); historical last-print anchor 0.322 (VALIDATE). Live (BUILD-live): touch 0.472 per add. Iteration 9: the price level carries the per-market margin (knockout: its prices quoted continuously +1.3%, its windows at the public anchor -2.3 to -4.5%), but neither a public game-state value (Dota V: 0.41 vs 0.43) nor a public tape-state model (0.285 vs 0.298) predicts its offset from the last print: the level is its private value. Taker: limit = stale ask + its own premium. Uncensored adds (BUILD-live): its add level relative to the others' mid predicts the others' mid move (Spearman 0.44 at 10 s, untriggered 0.38) vs 0.17 / 0.15 for other makers: the level is an informed private value that leads the public book.

exit.description: Never sells. Pulls the complement at its takes and re-posts ~1.03 s later; re-prices bids away from private adverse events between takes; merges complete pairs in one 300-s loop for CS2 and Dota (300.22 s + 7.28 s per merge; Dota merges within 30 s of a CS2 pass 68-88%) and holds the residual. Pair cost 0.978 (CS2), ~0.98 (Dota). Iteration 9: per-market residual is taken by group P (14.8% of maker shares, -4.1c per share on the residual), not group G (2.0%).
